title: Emit `unhashable-member` when creating sets or dicts
description:
## Type of Changes

<!-- Leave the corresponding lines for the applicable type of change: -->

|     | Type                   |
| --- | ---------------------- |
| ✓   | :sparkles: New feature |

## Description
Emit `unhashable-member` when creating sets or dicts, not just when accessing dicts.
Closes #7034
Closes #7055

diff --git a/pylint/checkers/utils.py b/pylint/checkers/utils.py
index 647b4e70a4..317cd91f2b 100644
--- a/pylint/checkers/utils.py
+++ b/pylint/checkers/utils.py
@@ -1854,3 +1854,22 @@ def find_assigned_names_recursive(
     elif isinstance(target, nodes.BaseContainer):
         for elt in target.elts:
             yield from find_assigned_names_recursive(elt)
+
+
+def is_hashable(node: nodes.NodeNG) -> bool:
+    """Return whether any inferred value of `node` is hashable.
+
+    When finding ambiguity, return True.
+    """
+    try:
+        for inferred in node.infer():
+            if inferred is astroid.Uninferable:
+                return True
+            hash_fn = next(inferred.igetattr("__hash__"))
+            if hash_fn.parent is inferred:
+                return True
+            if getattr(hash_fn, "value", True) is not None:
+                return True
+        return False
+    except astroid.InferenceError:
+        return True

+
+
+class Unhashable(object):
+    __hash__ = list.__hash__
+
+# Subscripts

+{}[{}] # [unhashable-member]

+{}[1:2]  # [unhashable-member]

+    [4, 5, 6]: "celeriac",  # [unhashable-member]

+{dict: {}}
